result.headline: Unconfirmed: Tornelis facing insolvency
result.assessment: Unverified rumour: one social-media post, no filing, statement or second source; feed search found no corroborating event. ERP shows Tornelis as financially stable. Not an event, so not material. If it were confirmed, the trace shows CBL-3 (not single-source, 50 days cover, above the 21-day buffer), products PRD-C and PRD-E, orders CO-003 and CO-006, EUR 426,000 in open orders. Not known: whether the claim is true, and whether CBL-3's alternate source is qualified.
result.lesson: An unverified supplier-insolvency rumour with no filing, statement or second source is not material; trace the contingent exposure anyway so it is ready if a confirmation appears.

options: Email SUP-NORD to confirm stoppage, restart date, open orders and releasable stock: EUR 0, reply asked within 48h. Drafted, held for Head of Supply Chain.

Email SUP-TORNA to confirm PCM-7 PPAP still valid, best lead time and price: EUR 0. Drafted, held for Head of Supply Chain. Needed because the ERP still shows PCM-7 as single-source and the Tornelis record lists only CBL-3 at 35 days, while the alternates list says qualified at 70 days.

PO to SUP-TORNA (qualified, price index 1.4): 8,000 units = 20 days of consumption, about EUR 425,600 at EUR 53.20/unit, 70 days lead. Not drafted: refused by control P-003 (above agent spend limit). Not split or resized to fit. Quantity is a judgement since stoppage duration is unknown.
Expedite on an open SUP-NORD order: cost and lead time unknown. Not drafted; I could not see any open PO, and the supplier is the one stopped. The Nordkamp email asks for this.

Re-allocate the 4,800 on-hand units (12 days at 400/day) to committed customer orders first: no purchase cost, immediate, but moves committed supply so needs Head of Supply Chain approval. Words only.
SUP-GREY (Greywater): 30 days, price index 0.95, but not qualified (no PPAP, never audited, financial health unknown). Rejected; not drafted.
result.lesson: A qualified second source with a 70-day lead cannot protect 12 days of cover; hold buffer stock or a standing order for single-source parts, and reconcile ERP source records before an event.

drafts_held.subject: PCM-7 supply: stoppage status and open order confirmation requested
drafts_held.body:
Dear Nordkamp team,

We have been informed of a stoppage affecting your supply of the Power Control Module PCM-7 to Halden Industrial. Please confirm by return:

1. Whether production or shipment of PCM-7 is currently stopped, the cause, and your expected restart date.
2. The status, quantity and confirmed ship date of every open Halden order for PCM-7.
3. Any finished goods or in-transit stock that can be released to us now, and the quantity.
4. Whether a partial or expedited shipment is possible, with cost and earliest delivery date.

Our consumption is 400 units per day, so we need a first answer within 48 hours to plan around committed customer orders.

Kind regards,
Halden Industrial Supply Chain
drafts_held.status: drafted, held for the Head of Supply Chain to sign off

Dear Tornelis team,

Halden Industrial may need to place an order with you for the Power Control Module PCM-7, for which we hold your PPAP from 2024. Before we do, please confirm:

1. That you can currently build PCM-7 to the approved PPAP, with no change in process or site since approval.
2. Your best lead time for 8,000 units. We have 70 days on record; please say whether a shorter time or a staged first delivery is possible, and at what cost.
3. Your unit price for that quantity and any stock or work in progress available sooner.

This is an enquiry, not an order. Any purchase order will follow separately once approved.

Kind regards,
Halden Industrial Supply Chain
